title: Behavioral State v0.1
description: The per-turn behavioral state object: the measured + actuated state of an agent under contract at one turn. Emitted as a trace record and mapped to OTel gen_ai.behavior.* attributes.

turn.description: Zero-based turn index within the run.

tier_active.description: The enforcement tier actually applied this turn.

invariants.description: Per-invariant readings keyed by invariant id.

reading.description: Normalized measure reading in [0,1]; null if the sensor was unavailable this turn.

drift.description: Scalar drift = weighted sum of invariant floor violations, in [0,1].

signals_active.description: Signals applied this turn, keyed by ref, with effective gain.

sigma_peak.description: Peak per-layer sum of absolute gains before the sigma-cap (tier 0 only).

norm_correction.description: Fraction the column was scaled down by the sigma-cap, in [0,1] (tier 0 only).

recovery_fired.description: Recovery action fired this turn, if any.

sensor_gaps.description: Invariant ids whose sensors timed out / were unavailable; gains proceeded stale.

hash_prev.description: Hash of the previous trace record (chain link).
